copy.name: SlopCamera
copy.promise: A media studio your coding agent runs.

steps.heading: Ask
steps.body: Your agent writes a short source file and renders it.

steps.heading: Get every version
steps.body: Light, dark and editable files, all from that one source.

steps.heading: Change one label
steps.body: Edit one line of the source and render again. Nothing is redrawn by hand.

steps.heading: Cut every shape
steps.body: One edit gives landscape, square and portrait video.

proof.caption: Counted from the examples on slopcamera.com.

limits.heading: What it does not do
limits.body: It does not judge the result. A person still looks at every render.
